comments.text:
If anyone has ever been to jury duty, it makes it even more hysterical. I’ve seen some crazy stuff at jury duty myself. Lol
The fact that it’s all non scripted and no re-takes is awesome. They get one shot in real time. 
Brilliant show and hilarious to see them sometimes crack each other up and try to hold back their laughter. Such a funny show!
